facts.fact: Central Government pensioners submit the annual life certificate to their pension disbursing agency in November every year
facts.quote: For annual life certificate, you should appear before your PDA in the month of November every year.

facts.fact: This year's window is 1-30 November 2026, so the last date is 30 November 2026
facts.quote: has issued directions to all the Pension Disbursing Banks to send SMSs/Emails to all their pensioners on 24th October, 1st November, 15th November and 25th November every year reminding them to submit their Annual Life Certificates by 30th November.
facts.note: The 2026 dates are derived from this standing annual rule; no DoPPW OM giving the 2026 Campaign 5.0 dates was found on pib.gov.in or doppw.gov.in on 28 Oct 2026.

facts.fact: Pensioners aged 80 and above can submit from 1 October (DoPPW order dated 18.07.2019), i.e. 1 October - 30 November 2026
facts.quote: This step is in addition to the order issued recently dated 18.07.2019 vide which all pensioners age 80 years and above have been given an exclusive window to submit their Life Certificate w.e.f. 1st October every year instead of 1st November every year.
facts.note: The 2026 dates are derived from the standing rule.

facts.fact: Pension disbursing banks send reminders and draw up an exception list as on 1 December of pensioners who have not submitted
facts.quote: directed all Pension Disbursing Banks to make an exception list as on 1st December every year of those pensioners who fail to submit their Life Certificate and issue another SMS/Email to them for submitting the Life Certificate.

facts.fact: The Nation-wide DLC Campaign 5.0 is running in 2026; camps are already being held (e.g. CCA Odisha, DoT, 23 Sept 2026)
facts.quote: on 23.09.2026 as part of the Nation-wide Digital Life Certificate Campaign 5.0.

facts.fact: The life certificate can be done from home: a Digital Life Certificate with Aadhaar face authentication needs only a smartphone
facts.quote: The Government of India has launched the Face Authentication Technique which requires only a smartphone for generation of DLCs.

facts.fact: Face authentication on Android needs Android 10 or above on an un-rooted device
facts.quote: System Requirements for Android 1. Android 10.0 or above (Un-rooted device).

facts.fact: Face authentication on iPhone needs iOS 14 or above on an un-rooted device
facts.quote: System Requirements for IOS 1. IOS 14.0 or above (Un-rooted device).

facts.fact: Two apps are needed: AadhaarFaceRd (UIDAI) and the Jeevan Pramaan Face App, from the Play Store / App Store
facts.quote: 2. Download and install AadhaarFaceRd from Play Store. 3. Download and install Jeevan Pramman Face App from Play Store.

facts.fact: The pensioner's Aadhaar must first be seeded (enrolled) in the pension account
facts.quote: Pensioners desirous of using the Jeevan Pramaan facility has to first enroll their Aadhaar number in their pension account.

facts.fact: Other option: a Jeevan Pramaan Centre run by CSCs, banks or government offices
facts.quote: Getting a digital Life certificate is hassle free and can be obtained through various Jeevan Pramaan Centres which are being operated by CSCs, Banks, Government offices or by using the client application on any PC/mobile/tablet.

facts.fact: Biometric authentication there is by fingerprint or iris
facts.quote: Provide your biometrics, either a finger print or Iris and authenticate your self.

facts.fact: Other option: IPPB doorstep DLC through the postman/Gramin Dak Sevak
facts.quote: To avail DLC service, a customer can contact the nearest post office or place a request for a doorstep visit by the postman/Grameen Dak Sevak.

facts.fact: Other option: banks also provide doorstep DLC service to aged/sick/divyang pensioners
facts.quote: Banks, IPPB and Pensioners’ Welfare associations took the lead in delivering doorstep services to the aged/sick/divyang pensioners.

facts.fact: Jeevan Pramaan is optional; the existing ways of submitting the life certificate (e.g. physically at the bank) remain
facts.quote: No, it is not. 'Jeevan Pramaan' is in addition to other existing facilities for submission of LIFE CERTIFICATE.

facts.fact: Step 2: open Jeevan Pramaan; on the Operator Authentication screen tick Aadhaar, enter the Aadhaar number, mobile number and email, and submit
facts.quote: They will be taken to the "Operator Authentication" screen where they have to provide their personal details as follows: 1. Click on the Aadhaar checkbox. 2. Enter the Aadhaar Number. 3. Enter the Mobile Number. 4. Enter the Email Address. 5. Click on the Submit Button.

facts.fact: Step 3: enter the pension details, including disbursing agency, PPO number and pension account number
facts.quote: 1. Full Name as per Aadhaar 2. Type of Pension 3. Sanctioning Authority 4. Disbursing Agency 5. PPO Number 6. Account Number (pension)

facts.fact: Then the face scan is done
facts.quote: A screen will appear for providing consent and permission for scan . Click on scan. The process for scanning face will begin.

facts.fact: Step 4: an SMS with the Jeevan Pramaan (Pramaan) ID confirms success
facts.quote: The pensioner shall also receive a SMS on the mobile number provided during pensioner identification, the SMS contains the Pramaan-id and the link from which the DLC can be downloaded.

facts.fact: The bank (pension disbursing agency) gets the DLC online; it need not be submitted physically
facts.quote: There is no need to physically submit the Digital Life Certificate to the Pension Disbursing Agency as it is automatically forwarded to the Pension Disbursing Agency mentioned by the pensioner in the Pensioner Identification Screen.

facts.fact: A PDF copy can be downloaded from the Jeevan Pramaan website using the Jeevan Pramaan ID
facts.quote: You can download a PDF copy of the certificate from the Jeevan Pramaan website by providing the Jeevan Pramaan ID.

summary: All claims confirmed on DoPPW/PIB/Jeevan Pramaan/IPPB pages; the 2026 dates (1-30 Nov, 80+ from 1 Oct) are derived from the standing annual rules since no 2026 Campaign 5.0 OM was found.
